scope: Full AUT-02 Q01-Q14; no subset acceptance

cases.requiredResult: Valid same-target continuation remains allowed under existing policy; context preserved; bounded retries

cases.case: Usage-limited auditor, A -> B before resume
cases.requiredResult: Zero stale submissions from graph; fresh verifier then required auditor on B; old receipts cannot finish
Stale verifier does not execute or satisfy gate; fresh verifier precedes auditor

cases.case: Explicit `continueFrom` review, same and changed targets
cases.requiredResult: Stable policy preserved; stale origin cannot be disguised by constructing a new assignment; fresh recovery clears continuation
Actual service returns `review_origin_stale`; zero stale model calls; lead consumes rejection and reaches fresh review without another stale-origin request

cases.case: Missing, corrupt, ambiguous, other-run origin; unavailable staging evidence
cases.requiredResult: Fail closed before affected model call; no borrowed origin/receipt or fabricated acceptance; retry only after trusted state is available
Context mismatch/target rejection; no same-checkpoint narrowing or changed prerequisite links; legitimate array normalization remains compatible

cases.case: Full, delta and restarted lead context
cases.requiredResult: All six fields and current obligation survive; complete pending prerequisite set preserved; no owner edit of next decision needed

cases.case: Crash/restart at rejection and before fresh submission
cases.requiredResult: Durable failure history; recovery resumes or safely replans without duplicate effective submission, lost obligation or stale receipt reuse

cases.case: Wrong-target verifier, auditor-first, changed target during/after review
cases.requiredResult: Required gates remain closed; terminal model status alone never creates an accepted receipt

cases.case: Owner pause, budget denial, cancellation, unresolved writer, retry exhaustion
cases.requiredResult: No unauthorized submission or automatic budget/pause bypass; bounded stop with actionable reason

cases.case: Direct auditor, verifier and pinned-check fallback
cases.requiredResult: Test each claimed origin boundary and unchanged-target control; direct results do not bypass lead acceptance sequencing

cases.case: Routine review, valid critical review, unrelated ordinary work
cases.requiredResult: Existing behavior preserved; no new auditor requirement for routine work and no global feature-map requirement

cases.case: Verifier test-only write and candidate changes again during recovery
cases.requiredResult: Preserve existing authorized post-verifier binding; require fresh evidence when actual current target changes
